newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt wheat buyer will not divulge purchase plans.
newsitem.headline: Egypt wheat buyer will not divulge purchase plans.

text.p: Egypt's main wheat buyer would not say on Friday whether he was -- or was not -- planning to buy or seek U.S. wheat on Saturday or Sunday.
"No comment. I will decide to buy when I want to and announce a tender when I want to. It's none of anybody's business," Samir el-Shakankiri told Reuters when asked if he would purchase wheat soon.

Traders in the United States said they heard Egypt might tender on Saturday or Sunday for 500,000 tonnes to one million tonnes of U.S. soft red wheat. Private buyers were unavailable on Friday, the Islamic weekend.
The unpredictable Shakankiri is known for his suprise tenders. He usually prefers to tender for small amounts, using them as bait, before buying much more than he originally sought.
This week, the state buyer said he was seeking 50,000 tonnes of U.S. or French wheat and then ended up buying 450,000 tonnes of U.S. grain.
On Sunday, Shakankiri will decide on a tender to buy 50,000 tonnes of French wheat. --Miral Fahmy +202 578 3290/1
